title: Taking out or moving one picture in a gallery (#93)
question: A gallery in a post can't lose or reorder a single picture yet: its pill only moves, adds to or takes out the whole gallery. Each sketch shows one way to do it at a desk (left) and on the phone (right), with the same three pictures. Pick one; the other two go. Dragging whole blocks, the gallery's outline and the captions are being fixed meanwhile and don't depend on this.

options.label: Arrange, then Done
options.thesis: The gallery's pill gains Arrange. Arranging lays the pictures out in place as equal, numbered tiles, each with its own handle and ×: drag to change the order (a finger on the phone, Alt ← → on a keyboard), × to take one out, Done to put the gallery back as it reads.
options.viewport: A post's gallery in Arranging: three equal tiles 1 2 3, the second being dragged after the third, a line under them saying how, and Done.
options.risk: One more step (Arrange, then Done) before you can touch a picture; the tiles don't show the gallery's real layout while arranging.

options.label: Click a picture to choose it
options.thesis: Clicking one picture inside a chosen gallery rings it in aqua and swaps in its own pill: move earlier, move later, replace, take it out, and back to the whole gallery. Nothing new to find: you click what you want to change.
materials: aqua ring on the chosen picture
options.viewport: The gallery chosen, its second picture ringed, its pill showing ‹ › replace and take out with the tooltip Take this picture out.
options.risk: Moving a picture several places takes several clicks; two levels of choosing (gallery, then picture) to learn.

options.label: A ⋯ on each picture
options.thesis: Every picture in a gallery carries a small ⋯ at its corner (on hover at a desk, always on the phone) that opens the shared menu: Move earlier, Move later, Replace, Take this picture out. The gallery's own pill doesn't change.
options.viewport: The gallery with its usual pill; the second picture's ⋯ open on Move earlier, Move later, Replace and Take this picture out.
options.risk: Several ⋯ buttons on the pictures at once on the phone; reordering is one step at a time.
